name: EPIC 211770011
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 6.8 solar radii and 1.13 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211770011 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM radius (solar radii) 6.842028 (16th-84th percentiles 6.610282-7.086984), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211770011 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.130314 (16th-84th percentiles 1.040434-1.230038), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211770011: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4777.4775 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211770011 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3576.875 (16th-84th percentiles 3479.53125-3677.421875), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.06 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,577 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.13 solar masses and 6.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,777 K at its surface.
